Computation names repeatable transformation of a field here; it does not turn every reality into a digital machine.

A supposedly source-aware system can be tested at the point where a corrected primary passage changes its inherited conclusion. The test concerns the relation between evidence, representation and consequence.

The paradigm version adds one further question: **what relation connects the explicit representation to the enacted field it claims to make inspectable?** If an edited paradigm map cannot change any source, permission, evaluator, capability, developmental form, material binding or relational frame, it may still be a valuable philosophical/visual account. It has not yet demonstrated Epi-Logos as an operating return.

The native parents `(0/1)/(1/0)` and `(1/0)/(0/1)` carry the complete body in inverse orientations. The first and returned accounts preserve their source relation. The optical relation places QL in the light's ordered spectrum, MEF in the refracting apparatus and pratibimba in the cast image. A technical world-picture is thus a reflection relative to the wider world; renaming it cannot make it metaphysically Original.

At this level **holographic** does not mean that a local map contains the whole. It means that the local reference can retain, at its own scale, the relation among source, mediation and projected determination. A Bimba Map is strongest when this whole-relation remains recoverable while the map performs its finite office; its recursive source-dependence is part of its authority, not a defect to conceal.

A local Bimba can govern reference within a bounded inquiry while remaining source-dependent and revisable within a wider frame. The account’s correction can reach that local reference itself. The same event read through Workcell's phenomenological and phenomenal pair brings forward another relation: an already situated being encounters a path through sensation, valuation, thought and anticipated possibility, within a body, history and temporal horizon. What the planner calls an equally short route may impose a different lived demand. The second pair does not negate the first. It supplies a difference the causal or numerical account must receive rather than silently translate away.

The §5 product field gives this principle a concrete sixfold without reducing MEF to product architecture. Each product is disclosed by a **whole pair**: Central by L0 Quaternal × L5′ Divine Logos; Actuation by L1 Causal × L4′ Scientific; AIKit by L2 Logical × L3′ Chronological; Software Factory by L3 Processual × L2′ Alchemical-Elemental; Workcell by L4 Phenomenological × L1′ Phenomenal; Quaternal Logic by L5 Para Vāk × L0′ Archetypal-Numerical. The pair discloses the product as one subject. Th

The stained-glass relation makes MEF the apparatus of refraction: panes, media, angles, joins and declared transformations. QL belongs to the ordered spectrum being articulated; MEF does not stand above it as a metalanguage that certifies every source. Historical, formal, psychic and technical claims retain their own evidence classes. Their non-equivalence is information for the inquiry.

The product field therefore becomes an unusually clear test of refraction. One philosophical whole—Objective Internality as the means within Life/Mind—is disclosed through six different but related offices. The products are not six competing metaphysics. They are six determinations of one mediating field, and each pair should let the reader see something that disappears when the product is treated as a software category alone.

[Count-to-Account](../etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD.md#count-to-account) changes the office of a distinction: its result becomes answerable through how the lens changed the question, evidence or judgment. The whole rotated Name/Power constellation remains available on either face; the selected lens does not replace it. Returned evidence must be able to alter the mediation used next. A counted distinction becomes an Account when the conditions of counting can be answered and

An inspectable lens and gauge explain how a judgment arose without making the framework its ontological source. Returned consequence must be able to change the selected mediation. A document, expectation, permission, tool or changed environment can carry this relation. What passes between participants acquires constitutive force: it enters what makes their later worlds available. [Objective Internality](C41-Objective-Internality.md) is the lived organisation of those means. Co-Internality is therefore **reciprocal paradigmatic constitution without merger**. Each centre remains capable of answering from a history and situation which the other's account does not exhaust.

The path is not exhausted by either account. The map represented it as passable; the report records a situated obstruction. A revised route can now change where the person travels and what they encounter next. When that further encounter returns, each participant's achieved act becomes a condition of the other's continuation. Records, tools and the resistant site mediate the relation together.

The planner's update does not give it authority to unlock the gate, nor does the person's report automatically change the rule governing access. Observation, representation and permission retain different offices. A common map can carry all three while keeping the sources and powers which distinguish them.

Federated reference maps make this differentiation explicit. Communities can retain locally authoritative maps and still disclose the relations through which their claims can be compared. A map's local authority concerns a declared field; it does not become ownership of every other field. The [Bimba–Pratibimba relation](C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) lets a derived reference serve further readings while retaining its dependence on wider sources.

Reciprocity requires a route of answer in both directions, though each encounter need not change both participants equally or simultaneously. A one-way update can be a constituent event in that wider relation. It does not by itself establish the whole reciprocal circuit. The next act supplies the discriminating evidence: what did the receiving participant inherit, and how could that use become answerable to the contributor?

[Dia / Syn](C50-Dia-Syn.md) makes the distinction precise. An encountered difference must remain distinct enough to be examined. A present report and an old map can disagree because their dates differ; a forbidden route and an efficient route can identify the same path under different criteria. These are not automatically logical contradictions. Cancellation would remove the distinction from the account; appropriation would let one term claim the whole relation and redescribe resistance as confi

In a constructed route-planning case, a report that a gate is locked can change the map while preserving the objective of reaching the destination quickly. Discovering that a proposed shortcut is not authorised changes the permitted action set. Discovering that the commission omitted a participant's access needs can change the criterion by which routes are judged. Each return has a different target. Repeating the original optimisation with a more emphatic explanation reaches none of them unless

A paradigm representation gives this criterion a definite case. If a system claims not merely to *represent* its paradigm but to make that paradigm inspectable and refinable, the claim must identify **which enacted mediating relation can be changed through the representation and what later operation changes with it**. A map that is accurate but causally disconnected from the field it maps may be valuable; it has not yet established paradigm-level Epi-Logos.

A comparison must preserve or account for the relevant conditions while testing the claimed difference. It must also put the distinction to work. Removing a permission-checking route from a task that never requests a restricted action need not change its result. That agreement does not establish that permission has no operational force; the task did not exercise the distinction. A discriminating comparison includes a case in which the relevant condition changes what the system can do. The mature

A difference between two outputs alone does not identify its cause. Variations in other inputs, permissions or generation must be held fixed where possible or accounted for by repeated, attributable comparisons. Conversely, if the first version routes the information through some other active channel, it was not a read-only control for the claimed operation. The comparison has to follow the actual path of influence rather than the interface's label.

The same logic applies to Epi-Logos. Compare an explicit paradigm representation that is **read-only** with one whose authorised changes can revise a governing relation—source, permission, evaluator, composition, material binding or containing frame—while task and other relevant conditions are held as stable as the test permits. A claim that the criterion itself became revisable needs evidence of which governing rule changed, how the change was authorised and which later act inherited it. The old evaluator can remain useful for a bounded comparison; its approval alone does not establish those further events. The source-return test makes the three findings concrete. A correction that never reaches the intended map can expose a broken implementation. First make a judgment's structure available: its lens, origin, exclusions, confidence, counterclaim and limit. The disclosure belongs before consequential action where it can affect delegation or correction. A polished retrospective account cannot substitute for conditions that actually governed the decision.

Encounter puts that structure under pressure. New evidence can contradict an answer; another participant can challenge a category; a failed test can reveal a useless mapping; material consequences can expose an omitted cost. Each discrepancy has to reach the level at which it arose. Repeated optimisation inside the same evaluator cannot remedy a defective evaluator by itself.

Preserve the path of change. An earlier determination can become inherited data with its scope, disagreement and failure retained, rather than a result silently relabelled as timeless knowledge. The next traversal should have a changed capacity. Repeating the same six labels or retaining logs without altered use does not establish cultivation.

This is where cultivation joins [Logos / Epi-Logos](C51-Logos-Epi-Logos.md). A paradigm becomes epi-logical when its articulated history of change can itself inform and revise the enacted pattern. Versioning is therefore not merely software hygiene in this register: it can preserve **why this source, criterion, permission or relation changed**, making later reversal or further change answerable to the encounter that prompted it. Keeping the old route does not mean continuing to recommend it. Its retained map version, source date, criterion and failure explain why it was once selected and why it was changed. A later reopening of the gate can then prompt another justified revision without making the earlier correction an error. The ensemble is not complete merely because its components have been named. Its operative relations must be followed.

Its alignment claim cannot be discharged by displaying the cuts while preventing every consequential challenge from reaching them. The operative question is whether a returned encounter can revise the relevant means, under attributable authority, and whether the next act inherits that revision.

The representation and its return also belong to relations among participants. A planner can expose why it selected a route while the affected person contests the aim for which that route was selected. Their powers are not interchangeable. [Shared worlds without merger](A30-prime-Shared-Worlds-Unmerged.md) keeps the encounter capable of changing both sides without giving either side complete possession of the other.
